title.zh: 子 Agent 卡片看得到完整输出，回答输出更平滑
title.en: Sub-agent cards show their full output, and answers stream more smoothly

zh: 子 Agent 卡片展开后显示它的完整输出：文字、思考和工具调用用与聊天页相同的样式呈现，运行中自动跟到最新内容。卡片标题收成一行，名字、类型和状态并排显示。
回答改为与 Desktop 相同的节奏逐字平滑输出，不再一阵一阵地跳；内容积压多时平稳加速、追上后平稳减速回平时的速度，新出现的字带淡入。
AI 讲解气泡更紧凑：顶部一行只放翻页、序号、标题和关闭按钮，只给正在看的那一段代码着色；点行号旁的序号标记可以显示或隐藏这一条讲解。
AI 可以一次打开多个文件，并把要你看的代码标成淡紫色的 AI 选区：选区锁在文件上，切换文件也还在，关掉这个文件才消失，AI 也可以一次取消。
en: Expanding a sub-agent card now shows its full output, with text, thinking and tool calls rendered the same way as in the chat, following the latest output while it runs. The card title fits on one line, with the name, type and status side by side.
Answers now stream out smoothly at the same pace as Desktop instead of arriving in bursts. When a lot of text piles up the speed eases up and then back down to the usual pace, and new text fades in.

The AI explanation bubble is more compact: a single header row with previous, next, position, title and a close button, and only the code being explained is highlighted. Click the numbered marker next to the line numbers to show or hide an explanation.

The AI can open several files at once and mark the code it wants you to look at as light purple AI selections. They stay on the file when you switch files, go away when you close that file, and the AI can clear them in one go.

zh: 第二个及之后派出的子 Agent 在运行时会显示成两张一模一样的卡片。
模型输出时界面发卡、风扇常转：聊天历史不再随每个字整份写一次存储，文件树、编辑区等页面其它部分也不再跟着回答重绘。
查看 AI 改动时左右两侧不再各显示一套：编辑区进入改动对比时左侧切到改动树，点「打开文件」回到普通编辑时左侧回到文件树，左侧切走时对比标签组也一并收起。去掉了标签栏上多余的「AI 改动」组名和返回按钮。
发送多行的提问后，回答输出时聊天不再停在原处、需要手动往下滚。
上下文用量在这一轮开始时就显示，不再要等回答结束；重新打开对话时直接显示上一次的用量。
子 Agent 读了几个大文件后会以「模型请求不变量校验失败」中断：现在大的工具结果会收成摘要，需要时 Agent 可以取回原文。
格式化文档不再把行内评论删掉、把讲解气泡和 AI 选区挤到文件开头，也不再在没装 Prettier 的 TS/JS 项目里删掉运算符和逗号两旁的空格；格式化只改动真正要变的地方，光标留在原处。
模型的思考内容不再整段重复一遍；一轮里后面步骤的思考也不再拼进前一步、工具卡上方的思考块里。
文件树里重命名时，输入框不再盖住上下两行和文件图标；按 Esc 取消重命名或收起搜索框时，也不再顺带把右侧的聊天面板收起来。
en: Sub-agents dispatched after the first one showed up as two identical cards while running.

The window lagged and the fans spun up while the model was answering: chat history is no longer written out in full for every token, and the rest of the page, such as the file tree and editor, no longer re-renders along with the answer.

Reviewing AI changes keeps both sides in step: the left panel shows the change tree while the editor compares, returns to the file tree when you choose Open file, and leaving the change tree closes the comparison tabs. The extra group label and back button are gone from the tab bar.
After sending a multi-line message, the chat now keeps following the answer instead of staying put until you scroll down.
Context usage shows as soon as a turn starts instead of only after the answer ends, and a reopened conversation shows its last usage right away.
Sub-agents no longer stop with a request invariant error after reading a few large files: large tool results are summarized and the agent can fetch the full text when it needs it.

Formatting a document no longer deletes inline comments, sends explanation bubbles and AI selections to the top of the file, or strips the spaces around operators and commas in TS/JS projects without Prettier. Only the text that needs to change is touched, and the cursor stays put.
The model's thinking no longer shows up twice, and a later step's thinking no longer gets merged into an earlier step's thinking block above its tool cards.
Renaming in the file tree no longer covers the rows above and below or the file icon, and pressing Esc to cancel a rename or close the search box no longer also collapses the chat panel.

title.zh: AI 在运行面板里跑命令、打开本机预览与读取问题
title.en: The AI runs commands in the Run panel, opens local previews, and reads problems

zh: AI 可以在底部「运行」面板里启动开发服务器、监听测试这类长驻命令，你能看到实时输出、随时停止；它会等服务就绪再继续，也会读输出判断有没有报错。可能改动项目的命令会先请你确认，破坏性命令直接拒绝。
开发服务器起来后，AI 可以把本机地址直接在 Workbench 内置浏览器里打开给你看；没开内置浏览器时用系统浏览器。
AI 可以读取编辑器报告的类型错误等问题，并把出问题的位置和「问题」面板打开给你看。
en: The AI can start long-running commands such as a dev server or tests in watch mode in the bottom Run panel, where you see the live output and can stop them. It waits for the server to be ready and reads the output to spot errors. Commands that may change the project ask you first, and destructive commands are refused.
Once a dev server is up, the AI can open its local address in Workbench's built-in browser, or in your system browser when the built-in one is off.
The AI can read the problems the editor reports, such as type errors, and show you the location and the Problems panel.

title.zh: AI 操作编辑器、代码讲解气泡与每一轮的 AI 改动
title.en: The AI works the editor, explains code in place, and shows every run's changes

zh: AI 可以直接操作编辑器：打开文件并定位到某一行或选中一段代码、在文件树里定位文件、打开某个文件的 Git 改动对比，也能读取你当前打开的文件和选中的代码。
AI 讲解代码时会把讲解气泡钉在对应代码旁边，多处讲解连成一条路线；气泡上可以上一条、下一条、收起或结束讲解，行号旁的标记可以随时展开某一处。
左侧新增「AI 改动」：按轮列出 AI 每一轮改过的文件，每轮一棵文件树；点开文件在编辑区的独立标签组里只读查看整份文件，新增的行为绿色、删除的行为红色。
一轮 AI 运行改了文件时，结束后会自动打开这一轮的改动（可在设置中关闭）；回答末尾改动卡的「审核」也会打开这里。停止或失败的一轮同样会记录改动。
en: The AI can now work the editor: open a file at a line or select a block of code, reveal a file in the file tree, open a file's Git diff, and read the file and selection you are looking at.

When the AI explains code, it pins explanation bubbles next to the code and links them into a walkthrough. Each bubble has previous, next, collapse, and end controls, and markers next to the line numbers expand any stop.

A new AI Changes view on the left lists the files each AI run changed, one file tree per run. Open a file to see the whole file read-only in its own editor tab group, with added lines in green and removed lines in red.

When a run changes files, its changes open automatically afterwards (you can turn this off in Settings), and the Review button on an answer's change card opens the same view. Runs that were stopped or failed record their changes too.

title.zh: 回答里的路径可点开、运行状态与估算费用
title.en: Clickable answer paths, run status, and cost estimates

zh: 运行中，状态行会显示模型正在做什么：思考到了哪个阶段，或正在执行哪个工具。
回答末尾会显示这一轮的估算费用（当前模型在价格表中有定价时）。
切换到别的对话再回来，会回到上次看到的位置。
输入框里的附件可以点击打开。
en: While a run is in progress, the status line shows what the model is doing: its current thinking stage or the tool it is running.
Answers now end with an estimated cost for the turn when the current model has a listed price.
Each conversation keeps its scroll position when you switch away and come back.
Attachments in the input box can be clicked to open.

zh: 回答里的文件路径现在可以点击：项目里的文件在编辑器中打开，项目外的文件用系统默认程序打开；回答末尾列出的文件也可以直接打开或在访达中显示。
en: File paths in answers are now clickable: project files open in the editor and files outside the project open with the system default app. Files listed at the end of an answer can be opened or shown in Finder.

title.zh: 本轮改动、目标模式与执行计划
title.en: Run changes, goal mode, and execution plans

zh: 每一轮回答末尾会列出这一轮改动过的文件和增删行数，可以展开查看逐行差异，也可以在编辑器中打开；逐行差异保存在本机数据目录，不占浏览器存储。
目标模式正式可用：开启后按你的消息建立目标，输入框上方的目标卡可以暂停、继续或移除目标。
模型可以为较长的任务建立并推进执行计划，进度显示在输入框上方。
已完成的回答会把处理过程收进「已处理」并显示耗时；停止或失败的回答末尾会标出状态。
en: Each answer now ends with the files that run changed and their added and removed lines; expand a file for a line-by-line diff or open it in the editor. The diffs are kept in the local data folder, not in browser storage.
Goal mode now works end to end: it sets a goal from your message, and the goal card above the input box lets you pause, continue, or remove it.
The model can set up and advance an execution plan for longer tasks, with progress shown above the input box.
Finished answers fold their work into a processed summary with the run time, and stopped or failed answers show their status at the end.

zh: 点「+」新建对话后，对话面板不再一直停在加载中。
en: Clicking + to start a new conversation no longer leaves the chat panel stuck loading.

title.zh: 运行中引导、会话回溯与聊天体验对齐
title.en: Run guidance, conversation rewind, and chat parity

zh: 运行中发送的消息会作为引导注入当前这一轮并显示引导进度，也可以选择本轮结束后再发送。
支持回溯到任意一条消息之前，可同时把项目文件恢复到那一轮开始前的状态。
在浏览器中拾取的页面元素会出现在输入框里，随消息一起交给模型。
主 Agent 派出子 Agent 时，可以指定当前模型厂商下已配置的任意模型；不指定时沿用主模型。
en: Messages sent while a run is in progress now reach the current run as guidance with visible progress; you can also choose to send after the run ends.
You can rewind the conversation to before any message, optionally restoring project files to how they were when that turn started.
Page elements picked in the browser now appear in the input box and are sent to the model with your message.
When the main agent dispatches a sub-agent, it can pick any configured model from the current provider; otherwise the sub-agent uses the main model.

zh: 从「提交」切回文件面板时，文件树顶部不再出现空白。
发出新一轮消息后，运行状态显示在新消息下方，不再先出现在上一轮回复上方。
子 Agent 不再一派发就报「模型 selection.provider 必须显式提供」。
中止或失败后再发的消息会接着那一轮继续；停止后，排队的消息不再自动发出。
回答中的文件路径和改动卡可以直接在编辑器中打开；单条消息渲染出错时只影响这一条。
en: The file tree no longer shows a blank top after switching back from the Commit view.
After you send a new message, the run status appears below it instead of above it on the previous reply.
Sub-agents no longer fail on dispatch with a missing model provider error.
A message sent after a stopped or failed run now continues that run, and queued messages are no longer sent automatically after you stop.
File paths and change cards in answers open in the editor, and a message that fails to render no longer breaks the whole conversation.

title.zh: 聊天能力对齐与代码块体验修复
title.en: Chat parity and code block fixes

zh: 工作台聊天支持操作审批、权限设置与子 Agent，与 Desktop 保持一致。
en: Workbench chat now supports action approvals, permission settings, and sub-agents, matching Desktop.

zh: 结构面板完整列出项目中的全部 Velar 源文件；运行档位恢复完整三档；状态栏更新进度改为与主题一致的轻量样式。
主题强调色只有一个来源，弹出菜单与主界面颜色保持一致。
回复输出过程中代码块不再反复刷新：点开的代码块保持展开，短代码块直接完整显示，鼠标停在代码块上页面可正常滚动。
模型长时间思考时显示「思考中」，只有真正断网重试时才显示「重连中」。
en: The structure panel now lists every Velar source file in the project, all three run profiles are available again, and the status-bar update progress uses a light, theme-matched style.
The theme accent now has a single source, so popovers match the main window.
Code blocks no longer refresh repeatedly while a reply streams: expanded blocks stay open, short blocks are shown in full, and the page scrolls normally over code blocks.
Long model pauses now show “Thinking”; “Reconnecting” only appears when a real network retry happens.

zh: 让本地发布工作流校验同时兼容 LF 与 CRLF 检出，确保 Windows 原生发布门禁稳定通过。
en: Made local release-workflow verification accept both LF and CRLF checkouts so the native Windows release gate remains deterministic.

title.zh: 游戏预览鼠标锁定修复
title.en: Pointer lock fix for game previews

zh: 修复 OpenVoxel 等游戏预览点击后无法锁定鼠标的问题，恢复依赖鼠标锁定的视角转向和键盘移动。
en: Fixed pointer lock after clicking game previews such as OpenVoxel, restoring mouse look and keyboard movement that depend on pointer lock.

title.zh: 统一且可靠的侧栏聊天

zh: 通过 Platform UI 与 Desktop 共用聊天组件和交互逻辑，同时保留 Workbench 专属组合边界。
en: Shared chat components and interaction logic with Desktop through Platform UI while preserving Workbench-specific composition.

zh: 将聊天内容限制在可调整宽度的侧栏内，并恢复稳定滚动、导航、紧凑代码块与更新进度显示。
让终止状态可靠收敛，并在取消运行时终止由 Workbench 持有的命令进程。
en: Kept chat content within the resizable sidebar and restored stable scrolling, navigation, compact code blocks, and update progress.
Made stop settlement deterministic and terminated Workbench-owned command processes when a run was cancelled.

title.zh: 跨平台语言服务与发布修复
title.en: Cross-platform language service and release fixes

zh: 规范化 Windows LSP 文件 URI，使诊断可靠映射回已打开的文档。
保持 macOS 发布路径检查确定，并继续在各原生平台独立发布。
en: Canonicalized Windows LSP file URIs so diagnostics map back to open documents reliably.
Kept macOS release path checks deterministic and preserved independent native-platform publication.

zh: 升级 System 至 1.1.16，并将直接与传递 Platform 依赖锁定到对应正式版本。
通过本地签名和公证链路发布 macOS arm64 候选。
en: Updated System to 1.1.16 and locked direct and transitive Platform dependencies to their corresponding published versions.
Published the macOS arm64 candidate through the local signing and notarization path.

zh: 将全部直接 Platform 包升级到 Platform 0.6.32 发布版本，并保持精确不可变依赖。
通过本地 Mac 签名和公证链路发布 macOS arm64 候选。
en: Updated every direct Platform package to the Platform 0.6.32 release while retaining exact immutable dependencies.
Published the macOS arm64 candidate through the local Mac signing and notarization path.

zh: macOS、Windows 与 Linux 的打包结果现在可以独立发布。
en: macOS, Windows, and Linux packaging results can now be published independently.

zh: 单个平台失败或不可用不再阻塞已成功平台生成签名候选目录。
后续平台运行会追加已验证资产，而不会替换先前发布的下载。
en: A failed or unavailable platform no longer blocks successful platforms from producing a signed candidate catalog.
Later platform runs append verified assets without replacing previously published downloads.

zh: 统一分支选择菜单在普通与懒加载状态下的边框、背景和阴影。
修复搜索区域与窗口拖拽冲突，并让浮层正确自动聚焦和恢复焦点。
en: Unified branch-menu borders, backgrounds, and shadows across normal and lazy-loaded states.
Fixed conflicts with window dragging and restored correct autofocus and focus return for overlays.

zh: 对齐 Platform 工具安全边界，强化浏览器脚本、Windows 命令路径与破坏性命令识别。
加强 Office 预览净化和媒体路径校验，避免不可信内容进入预览。
将路径提示改为线性扫描，并收紧跨平台路径、模型别名和工具结果解析。
en: Aligned Platform tool-safety boundaries for browser scripts, Windows command paths, and destructive-command detection.
Hardened Office preview sanitization and media-path validation against untrusted content.
Moved path suggestions to linear scanning and tightened cross-platform path, model-alias, and tool-result parsing.

zh: 为模型配置和托管模型目录加入可订阅更新，使已打开的界面在刷新后立即同步。
en: Added subscriptions for model configuration and managed catalogs so open interfaces update immediately after refresh.

zh: 稳定显示 VelarOS 与 VelarOS-Dev，并明确标记暂时不可用的服务。
刷新期间保留最后一次成功快照，并拒绝过期界面状态提交的模型选择。
en: Stabilized VelarOS and VelarOS-Dev display names and clearly marked temporarily unavailable services.
Kept the last successful snapshot during refresh and rejected model selections submitted from stale interface state.

title.zh: 可信发布与启动体积门禁

zh: 重构更新发布事务，记录原生平台、架构、签名状态和验证证据，并在 completion 前验证远端字节与签名目录。
新增 main、renderer 及首屏资源体积预算，防止启动成本回归。
en: Reworked the update transaction to record native platform, architecture, signature state, and evidence, then verify remote bytes and the signed catalog before completion.
Added size budgets for main, renderer, and startup resources to prevent startup-cost regressions.

zh: 升级共享 Platform 执行栈，修正取消语义并收窄语言操作的运行时依赖边界。
en: Updated the shared Platform execution stack, corrected cancellation semantics, and narrowed language-operation runtime dependencies.

title.zh: 预览交互与共享执行栈

zh: 图片预览加入缩放、适应窗口、快捷键和放大后拖动。
Agent 与行内补全接入共享执行及模型请求栈，同时保留真实工具 schema 和调用身份。
en: Added zoom controls, fit-to-window, shortcuts, and panning for enlarged image previews.
Moved Agent execution and inline completion onto shared execution and model-request stacks while preserving real tool schemas and call identity.

zh: 改进终端输出高亮和控制序列处理，使内容与工具面板样式保持一致。
en: Improved terminal highlighting and control-sequence handling so output remains consistent with tool-panel styling.
